summary_1line: Dasaratha visits King Lomapada and receives permission for the sage Rishyasringa and Shanta to come to Ayodhya to officiate a sacrifice for sons.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha arrives at Lomapada’s court and beholds the radiant sage Rishyasringa shining like fire beside the king.
King Lomapada grants permission as the young sage Rishyasringa stands with Princess Shanta, preparing to depart with Dasaratha.
Citizens of Ayodhya joyfully watch as King Dasaratha ceremonially leads the youthful sage Rishyasringa into the city.
